how_to_reach_en: Walk in on any weekday. Bring your student card; nobody asks why you need it.
how_to_reach_zu: Ngena nganoma yiluphi usuku lwesonto. Letha ikhadi lakho lomfundi; akekho obuza ukuthi kungani uludinga.

how_to_reach_en: Karoo Coast has no residences of its own. The Housing Desk keeps the list of accredited private rooms and checks leases with you.
how_to_reach_zu: I-Karoo Coast ayinazo izindawo zayo zokuhlala. Ideski Lezindawo Zokuhlala ligcina uhlu lwamakamelo azimele agunyaziwe futhi lihlola izivumelwano nawe.
